title: This is what Qwen 3.8 27b is capable of
body:
https://ocean.blackbeardlabs.dev/

Qwen 3.8 27b Q8_X_KL Unsloth

/goal I want you to create a **JavaScript + Node.js WebGL project** that renders a highly realistic real-time ocean in the browser. Use **JavaScript only, no TypeScript**. You may use WebGL2, GLSL, and Three.js. The ocean should include realistic waves, vertex displacement, Fresnel reflections, sun highlights, sky/environment reflection, foam/whitecaps, horizon treatment, atmospheric effects, and adjustable wind/wave/sun parameters. Keep it suitable for a real-time browser game, GPU-driven where possible, and organize the code cleanly instead of putting everything in one file.

submitted by /u/BlackBeardAI
